QuestInfo.name: The Fickle Stone
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has something to tell you...
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra has something to tell you...

0.0: #b#h0##k, did you really lose the #bStone of Virtue#k that I gave you? Don't try to hide it. Do you want your Stone of Virtue back?

no.0: If you don't want it anymore, that's fine. Just remember, you can't use the Knights of Virtue's special powers without a Stone of Virtue.

yes.0: Well, okay. I do wonder HOW you lost something as important as the Stone of Virtue, but I will give you another chance. Here, take good care of this one.
yes.1: I know what you're thinking, and the answer is yes. Yes, I DO have your Stone of Virtue. And no, I'm NOT going to tell you how I got it. Hahahaha...

default.0: Honestly, I don't think you deserve another Stone of Virtue.
